headline: FAA issues nationwide ground-stop order, delaying or canceling nearly 7,000 flights

members.title: FAA issues nationwide ground-stop order, delaying or canceling nearly 7,000 flights
members.lead: Transportation secretary said stoppage is due to ‘communication issue’ and homeland security says there’s no indication of ‘nefarious attack’ Flights grounded at all US airports due to communications outage – live The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has issued a nationwide ground stop for all flights that are due to take off in the US on Friday, delaying or canceling nearly 7,000 US flights, according to aviation tracker FlightAware. In a post on X, Sean Duffy, the US transportation secretary, said the stoppage is due to “a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers” and that the FAA’s technicians are looking into the matter.
